records.title: UAT-PROBE TRICYCLE REGISTRATION ORDINANCE [verified]
records.content:
Republic of the Philippines
Municipality of Pitogo, Province of Quezon
Office of the Sangguniang Bayan

Ordinance No. 9911, Series of 2091

UAT-PROBE TRICYCLE REGISTRATION ORDINANCE

SECTION 1. Short Title. This Ordinance shall be known as the UAT-PROBE Tricycle Registration Ordinance.
SECTION 2. Registration. All tricycle operators shall register their vehicles with the municipal treasurer.
SECTION 3. Fees. A registration fee shall be collected annually.
SECTION 4. Penalties. Violators shall be fined accordingly.
